name: jesse-agent
description: A personal AI agent built from scratch in TypeScript. No frameworks, no SDK — a hand-written agentic loop, learned by reverse-engineering Claude Code.
//type: ESM module system (chosen over CommonJS). Lets us write `import ... from './x.js'`, use top-level await, and matches Claude Code's source + a future web target.
//scripts: dev runs TS directly via tsx (no build step, fast feedback while learning). build/start are for later when we ship compiled JS.

scripts.desktop:build: npm run desktop:check && vite build --config desktop-app/vite.config.ts
scripts.test:quick: npm run build && node --test dist/*.test.js && npm run test:web
scripts.package:vscode: mkdir -p dist && cd vscode-extension && npm exec --package @vscode/vsce -- vsce package --no-dependencies --out ../dist/jesse-agent-vscode-0.0.7.vsix

//engines: Node 20.19+ required by the React/Vite desktop build. We're on v22.
//devDependencies: The agent core uses Node built-ins; React and Vite build the reusable desktop/web UI layer.
